subject: Taxes
title: Nike's Dutch Shell
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Nike's Dutch Shell.

hook.text: Nike shifted its brand licensing rights to a Dutch subsidiary.

buildup.text: The Dutch subsidiary owns the Nike 'swoosh' trademark.

discovery.text: The Netherlands taxes royalty income at favorable rates.

twist.text: The Dutch subsidiary has minimal staff. The real marketing, design, and strategy happen in Oregon.

climax.text: Nike's structure is standard practice for consumer brands.

punchline.text: Designed in Oregon. Profit in Amsterdam. The swoosh lives in the Netherlands.

quiz.question: How does Nike reduce its global tax bill?
options: By shifting brand licensing rights to a Dutch subsidiary
